text: City Council, at its meeting on December 4, 5 and 13, 2018, approved the appointment of an Interim Controller, pending the completion of a recruitment process to appoint a permanent Controller. Having completed the recruitment process, this report recommends the appointment of the individual named in a Confidential Attachment, to the position of Controller, and to the statutory office of Deputy Treasurer for the City of Toronto. This matter is urgent to conclude the recruitment process and enable the successful candidate to commence employment in a timely manner. The appointment of the Controller is a statutory appointment that requires Council's approval as per the City of Toronto Act, 2006.

City Council on January 30 and 31, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint Andrew J. Flynn to the position of Controller, and to the statutory office of Deputy Treasurer for the City of Toronto for the purposes of section 138 of the City of Toronto Act, with such appointment to be effective March 11, 2019. 2. City Council authorize the public release of Andrew J. Flynn's curriculum vitae summary. The following curriculum vitae summary for Andrew J.
